name: Pegasus Medical Centre website
note: Direction C (editorial homepage). These values are the ones implemented in apps/web/src/app/globals.css; if the two ever differ, globals.css is wrong. Version 2 (Montserrat-only, 8px radius, filled buttons) is superseded.

deep-teal.usage: Text, dark bands (header, footer, feature band), the ink inside a hovered circle.

teal.usage: Hover colour for links, the focus ring on white and Pale Neutral. 4.93:1 on white, 4.17:1 on Pale Neutral.

soft-green.usage: Accent: circle-arrow fills, hairlines and rules, labels on Deep Teal, the focus ring on Deep Teal. Never text on white (2.15:1).

pale-neutral.usage: One cream band per page at most (for example Visit us).

white.usage: Page background; text on Deep Teal and on photos.

color.shade-hero: Two linear gradients over the hero photo only: vertical rgba(0,61,58,0 → .05 at 40% → .78) and horizontal from the left rgba(0,61,58,.45 → .1 at 55% → 0). The only gradient on the site.
color.texture: Feather-line pattern (public/brand/feather-line-pattern-*.svg) at 7% opacity on at most one band per page, never under text at its busiest.
color.black: Print and one-colour logo files only. Not used on the website.
contrast: labels and small print on dark bands
decoration only, never text, never a focus ring

serif.usage: h1–h3, primary actions, pull quotes. Files in apps/web/src/fonts.

sans.usage: Everything else. From the brand package.

type.floor: 16px for anything a patient reads. Build-time markers (the Temporary photo badge) are not patient content.

shape.radius-photo: 160px desktop / 80px phone, on ONE corner of a strip photo

actions.primary: Lora text + 64px soft-green filled circle with a 26px arrow. On hover the text underlines in soft green and the circle scales 1.06 (white on photos and dark bands, Deep Teal on white). One per screen.
actions.secondary: Montserrat 600 text + 48px circle outlined 2px soft green. On hover the circle fills soft green.
actions.book-rule: One Book on screen at a time. The hero's Book is marked data-hero-book; the header Book and the phone bar appear only after it scrolls out of view. Pages without a hero Book show them from the start.

layout.phone-bar: 80px, Book + Call, pinned to the bottom under 768px
layout.nav-collapse: Under 1280px the nav folds into a full-screen dialog menu

motion.reveal: Sections rise 24px and fade in once on scroll (IntersectionObserver), 700ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)
motion.hero: Headline, intro and actions rise in sequence 100/220/340ms
motion.reduced-motion: All of the above off under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

links.in-text: Always underlined, 1.5px, 5px offset; hover turns Teal
links.menus-and-lists: Header nav, footer link lists and row links (a service row, a quick-action tile) are not underlined at rest; they underline on hover and show the circle response
links.on-dark: White text, hover underline in soft green
